mechanism_narrative: Increasing GDP indicates strong economic activity, leading to higher S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: GDP growth does not correlate with positive S&P returns over 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment suggests a strong economy, boosting S&P 500.
failure_condition: Unemployment below 4% does not lead to positive 20-day returns.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production and employment indicate economic expansion.
failure_condition: No positive correlation between industrial production, employment, and S&P returns.

mechanism_narrative: Higher Fed Funds in tightening cycles may reduce returns.
failure_condition: Negative returns not observed during monetary tightening.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing housing starts reflect strong demand, boosting S&P 500.
failure_condition: Housing starts growth does not lead to positive 60-day returns.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation may lead to monetary tightening, reducing returns.
failure_condition: Inflation above 310 does not lead to negative 5-day returns.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth and low unemployment signal strong economy, boosting S&P 500.
failure_condition: No positive correlation between GDP, unemployment, and S&P returns.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment in late-cycle expansion may not boost returns.
failure_condition: Unemployment below 4% in late-cycle does not lead to positive 20-day returns.
